## Description

Models market making as a Stackelberg leader-follower game where institutional market maker agents act as leaders setting optimal quotes against reactive noise trader follower populations.

## Where it may fit

High-frequency limit order book market making, competitive exchange liquidity provision.

## Vehicles

HFT Market Makers, Proprietary Trading Desks.

## Required data

Level 2/3 limit order book message feeds, trade execution logs, order cancellation queues.

## Caveats

Stackelberg equilibrium optimization requires nested reinforcement learning loops and simulation environments.
